page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred verse with a running head above the heading; a signature line below the verse at right; a catchword-like "AD TABV" at the lower right margin. No marginal notes in legible form (faint show-through from the other side is ignored).

main_text.head: BARTHOLOMÆI KECKERMANNI PHILOSOPHI solertissimi
EPIGRAMMA.
main_text.p:
SAGAX Aleipta litteratæ Gymnados,
Et arbiter certaminum
Parnassiorum doctæ in circo Palladøs,
Qua Sole sub BORVSSICO
DANTISCVM, ocellus ille ciuitatium
Serpentis vndas VISTVLÆ
Miscere gaudet, ostio septemplici,
BALTHES profundo, cor meæ
Versus Camenæ flagitas, Methodo recens
Abs te iuuentuti cate
Delineata ad imprimendos, ut solet?
Pol haud necesse est. nam satis
Semet Tabellulæ, illices Tabellulæ
Probant cuiuis vberem ob
Vim commodorum, queis de hinc Scholasticos
Passim beabunt pulueres.
Quin auctor ipse sic clues: Soli iubar
Vt more moro adfundere
Existimetur, si tuæ quis laureæ
Hederam addidisse flexilem
Stulte adlaboret. Hercle KECKERMANO opus
LAVBANIIS nil versibus.

page.notes: Two-line decorative band at the top is an ornament, not transcribed. The Greek-style letters "ꝑ" and similar are as printed. Lower-right "AD TABV" is a fragmentary marginal tag, reproduced as printed; the lower text is partly cut off. Some line-end words are uncertain due to the scan.
